name: Dragonfly
line: Redis-compatible key-value storage with managed Cloud and self-hosted options.

free.text: Self-host: 100 production vCPUs; Cloud bills active; no idle pause/deletion

cells.regions: AWS, GCP, or Azure; choose a region per datastore
cells.selfhost: Yes, DSAL free up to 100 aggregate production vCPUs

sql.math: 3 GB development instances cost about USD $36 a month. Whether the data fits, transfer and the exact total are unknown.
The 12.5 GB example costs USD $137.50 a month while active. Whether the minimum size fits and network charges are unknown.

files.math: Dragonfly has no file storage product.

jobs.math: Workers run separately. A 12.5 GB broker adds USD $137.50 a month, if it is big enough. Worker cost and the full total are unknown.
